fields.Name: Collaboration Home Open Tasks
fields.Description: The open tasks (neither completed nor cancelled) filed in the spaces a person reaches, each once under the first of those spaces by name (read from the person's items, through the access function once), soonest due first, up to 50: the rows behind the Open Tasks count of Collaboration Home Counts, with the same rules. Only the Integration role may run it: the server runs it as the system user, with the signed-in person's own id, through GetHomeLists.
fields.SQL:
SELECT TOP 50
    t.ID AS TaskID,
    t.Name AS TaskName,
    t.Status,
    t.Priority,
    t.DueAt,
    x.SpaceID,
    x.SpaceName
FROM (
    SELECT TRY_CAST(REPLACE(i.RecordID, N'ID|', N'') AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER) AS TaskID,
           i.SpaceID,
           s.Name AS SpaceName,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY TRY_CAST(REPLACE(i.RecordID, N'ID|', N'') AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER) ORDER BY s.Name, s.ID) AS rn
      FROM [__mj_BizAppsCollaboration].[SpaceItem] i
      INNER JOIN [__mj_BizAppsCollaboration].[fnCollaborationAccess]({{ UserID | sqlString }}) a ON a.SpaceID = i.SpaceID
      INNER JOIN [__mj_BizAppsCollaboration].[Space] s ON s.ID = i.SpaceID
     WHERE i.Band = N'Shared' OR a.CanSeeTeam = 1
) x
INNER JOIN [__mj_BizAppsTasks].[Task] t ON t.ID = x.TaskID
WHERE x.rn = 1
  AND t.Status NOT IN (N'Completed', N'Cancelled')
ORDER BY CASE WHEN t.DueAt IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, t.DueAt, t.Name
